say:0:1720211001:1.text: Despite spending time and money at the tavern, you learn nothing of value.
say:0:1720211001:1.source_cn: 绕了一圈，废了钱又废了口水，什么有价值的信息都没打听到。
say:0:1720211001:1.male: Despite spending time and money at the tavern, you learn nothing of value.
say:0:1720211001:1.female: Despite spending time and money at the tavern, you learn nothing of value.

say:1:1720211002:1.text: You make a mental note not to go along with every idea the little fox comes up with next time.
say:1:1720211002:1.source_cn: 你发誓，下次一定要仔细辨别小狐狸出的鬼点子，好好判断一...
say:1:1720211002:1.male: You make a mental note not to go along with every idea the little fox comes up with next time.
say:1:1720211002:1.female: You make a mental note not to go along with every idea the little fox comes up with next time.

say:2:1720211003:1.text: Come to think of it, where's that sneaky fox?
say:2:1720211003:1.source_cn: 说起来，那只躲起来喝酒偷懒的小狐狸去哪里了？
